title: What's new in SalonOX
message: This update makes SalonOX faster and smoother, especially for salons with lots of data.

notes.title: Faster lists
notes.description: Services, clients, consumables and sales now load much faster, even with large amounts of data.

notes.title: Better WhatsApp inbox
notes.description: Chats open on the latest message, the keyboard no longer hides your messages, and names and numbers show in full.

notes.title: Clearer date filters
notes.description: The date range you pick, like This month or Last month, is now clearly highlighted.

notes.title: Password reset fixed
notes.description: Resetting your password after verifying the OTP now works correctly.
